theorem R1Z.PV_OWNC_InPlaceResult.guarded : ∀ (q : R1Z.PV_OWNB_Cursor.Cursor) (keep : R1Z.PV_OWN_Link.Link → Bool),
  R1Z.PV_OWNB_Cursor.Valid q →
    ∀ (guard result : Nat),
      q.memory.slots guard = none →
        q.memory.slots result = none →
          guard ≠ q.owner →
            result ≠ q.owner →
              result ≠ guard →
                have filtered := R1Z.PV_OWNC_SourceLoop.run keep (q.length - q.read) q;
                have guarded := R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardState.handoff filtered guard;
                have returned := R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardState.handoff guarded result;
                R1Z.PV_OWNB_Cursor.Valid returned ∧ returned.token = q.token ∧ returned.memory.slots guard = none :=
fun q keep h guard result ge re gs rs rg =>
  id
    (have hi := R1Z.PV_OWNC_SourceIdentity.loop keep (q.length - q.read) q;
    have hf := (R1Z.PV_OWNC_SourceLoop.completed keep q h).left;
    let filtered := R1Z.PV_OWNC_SourceLoop.run keep (q.length - q.read) q;
    have hge := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a guard = none) hi.right.right.left)) ge;
    have hgs := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => guard ≠ _a) hi.left)) gs;
    have hg := R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardValid.valid filtered hf guard hge hgs;
    have hrs := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => result ≠ _a) hi.left)) rs;
    have hfe := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a result = none) hi.right.right.left)) re;
    have hre :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg Eq
              (ite_congr (eq_false hrs) (fun a => Eq.refl none) fun a =>
                ite_congr (eq_false rg) (fun a => Eq.refl (some filtered.token)) fun a =>
                  Eq.refl (filtered.memory.slots result)))
            none))
        hfe;
    ⟨R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardValid.valid (R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardState.handoff filtered guard) hg result hre rg,
      ⟨hi.right.left,
        R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardTransfer.source_consumed (R1Z.PV_OWNC_GuardState.handoff filtered guard) result⟩⟩)
